# Vignette

Darkening toward the corners of the frame. One per world; with none
declared, there is no vignette.

## Parameters

- `strength`: A float. Vignette strength in `[0, 1]`. 0 disables the corner darkening. Defaults to `0.0`. Clamped to `[0, 1]`. Applies live.
